description: Flat metadata schema for individual marine microbiome sequencing samples collected from oceanic regions, including environmental context, sample type, extraction, and sequencing details.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample name or label used in the project.

collection_date.descr: Date when the sample was collected (ISO 8601 format recommended, e.g., 2026-08-18).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection, if available (24-hour time recommended, e.g., 14:35:00).

ocean_region.descr: Broad oceanic region where the sample was collected, e.g., Pacific Ocean, Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, Southern Ocean, Arctic Ocean.

sampling_site_name.descr: Name or label of the sampling site, station, cruise station, transect point, or location.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees; use negative values for southern hemisphere.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees; use negative values for western hemisphere.

coordinate_uncertainty_m.descr: Estimated uncertainty of the geographic coordinates in meters.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Depth at which the sample was collected, in meters below surface or seafloor as applicable.

depth_reference.descr: Reference used for depth measurement, e.g., below sea surface, below seafloor, water column depth.

sample_matrix.descr: Primary sample material, e.g., seawater, sediment, marine organism microbiome, biofilm, sponge tissue.

host_organism.descr: Host organism associated with the microbiome, if applicable; otherwise blank or not applicable.

host_taxon.descr: Scientific name or taxonomic label of the host organism, if applicable.

environment_type.descr: Environmental context of the sample, e.g., pelagic, benthic, coastal, estuarine, open ocean, deep sea.

temperature_c.descr: In situ temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius.

salinity_psu.descr: In situ salinity at sampling time, in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: In situ pH measured at sampling time.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration at sampling time, in mg/L.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Water turbidity at sampling time, in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

conductivity_ms_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity of the sample water, in mS/cm, if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration, in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

ammonium_umol_l.descr: Ammonium concentration, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

oxygen_minimum_zone.descr: Indicates whether the sample was collected from an oxygen minimum zone or hypoxic environment.

sampling_instrument.descr: Primary instrument or device used to collect the sample, e.g., Niskin bottle, grab sampler, corer, net.

collection_method.descr: Brief description of the collection protocol used to obtain the sample.

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample after collection, e.g., flash freezing, ethanol, RNAlater, dry ice.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature of the sample prior to nucleic acid extraction, in degrees Celsius.

filtration_used.descr: Indicates whether filtration was used to concentrate cells or particulates prior to extraction.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used during sample processing, in micrometers (µm), if filtration was used.

filter_material.descr: Filter membrane material, e.g., GF/F, polycarbonate, nitrocellulose, PES, if applicable.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of seawater or other liquid processed for the sample, in liters, if applicable.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of sediment, tissue, or other solid material processed, in grams, if applicable.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used for DNA extraction, including kit name or method version.

rna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used for RNA extraction, if RNA was extracted.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid analyzed, e.g., DNA, RNA, mixed DNA/RNA.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

target_region.descr: Targeted gene or region for sequencing, e.g., 16S rRNA, 18S rRNA, ITS, shotgun metagenome.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument or platform used, e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

sequencing_layout.descr: Read layout, e.g., single-end, paired-end, long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal sequencing read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for the sample, if known.

barcode_or_index.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence/label used for multiplexing, if applicable.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the technical replicate, if the sample was sequenced more than once.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the biological replicate, if applicable.

blank_control_included.descr: Indicates whether an extraction or library blank control was included alongside the sample.

positive_control_included.descr: Indicates whether a positive control was included alongside the sample.

taxonomic_annotation_method.descr: Method or pipeline used for taxonomic assignment, if applicable.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method or pipeline used for functional annotation of reads or assembled sequences, if applicable.

assembly_method.descr: Assembly software or approach used, if metagenomic assembly was performed.

database_version.descr: Reference database name and version used for annotation, if applicable.

sample_notes.descr: Free-text notes about unusual conditions, deviations from protocol, or interpretation-relevant details.

associated_accession.descr: External accession or identifier linking the sample to a repository or archive, if available.
